question_text: A class of 40 students has 60% girls. After some girls leave, girls become 50%. How many girls left?

hint_ladder.title: Let x = sold strawberry candies
hint_ladder.text: After selling, strawberry = 24 – x, total candies = 40 – x. New percent: (24 – x)/(40 – x) = 50% = 0.5.

hint_ladder.title: Answer: 8 strawberry sold
hint_ladder.text: Check: New strawberry = 16, new total = 32, 16/32 = 50%. Kaya 8 ang nabentang strawberry candies.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you used the original total: (24 – x)/40 = 0.5, giving x = 4, then mistakenly added 2.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you thought girls should equal boys (16) after removal, so x=8, then mistakenly added 2 to get 10.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you confused percentage points with percent: 60%–50%=10% of 40=4, then tripled to 12.

next_time_rule: When part of a set leaves, both total and part change. Set equation: (original part – x)/(original total – x) = new percentage. Solve for x.
deconstruct_text:
**Watch-Out Zone: wrong_base_percentage** in action. Laging gamitin ang bagong total.

Imagine a sari-sari store near the palengke. Nag-order ng 40 candies: 60% strawberry (24 piraso), 40% chocolate (16 piraso). Matapos ibenta ang ilang strawberry candies, ang natirang strawberry ay 50% na lang ng lahat ng candies.

Set up natin: let x = bilang ng nabentang strawberry candies. Pagkatapos, strawberry = 24 – x, total candies = 40 – x. Dapat (24 – x)/(40 – x) = 0.5. Multiply both sides by (40 – x): 24 – x = 0.5(40 – x) → 24 – x = 20 – 0.5x. Combine: 24 – 20 = x – 0.5x → 4 = 0.5x → ...

Kaya 8 strawberry candies ang nabenta. Check: bagong strawberry = 16, bagong total = 32, at 16/32 = 50%. Perfect!

Tandaan ang Taglish mnemonic: 'Kapag may umalis, bagong part over bagong total equals bagong percent.' Parang sa budget ng barangay: kung may natanggal na pondo para sa health center, i-update ang kabuuang pondo bago kalkulahin ang porsyento ng natirang health budget.
